admission_before_any_write: Independently inspect actual schema/column typmods/permissions under approved DB workflow
Reject constrained/truncating tick or OHLCV numeric storage and submillisecond timestamp precision
Verify exact Decimal19dp/tiny quantity/year9999 timestamp roundtrip before adoption
Require source/destination row/hash/clock receipts; no auto adopting old rows

if_narrow_schema.strategy: Explicit reviewed fresh versioned instrument/exact-history schema, not silent ALTER/adoption
if_narrow_schema.source_requirement: Original hash-bound raw metadata/history bytes or admitted current metadata refetch
if_narrow_schema.refetch_limit: Current refetch is NOT a historical tick or PIT reconstruction
if_narrow_schema.missing_original: Rounded old numeric row alone cannot recover discarded digits: precision UNKNOWN and retain old source
if_narrow_schema.rollback: Select prior release/schema; retain both namespaces and WAL/receipts; no destructive cleanup
